name: Invoice Financing Agreement
definition: Set of characteristics that unambiguously identify an invoice financing agreement. An invoice financing agreement between a factor and its client allows to transfer a payment obligation that exists between the client and a third party from the client to the factor.

Authorisation.name: Authorisation
Authorisation.definition: User identification or any user key that allows to check if the financing requestor is allowed to ask for invoice financing.|Usage: the content is not of a technical nature, but reflects the organisational structure at the requesting side. The authorisation element can typically be used in case the financing requestor acts on behalf of one or more suppliers.

FinancingMethod.name: Financing Method
FinancingMethod.definition: Specifies the financing method related to invoice financing (eg collection mandate).

RequestedAmount.name: Requested Amount
RequestedAmount.definition: Amount requested by the requestor party, related to a single invoice to be financed.

RequestedPercentage.name: Requested Percentage
RequestedPercentage.definition: Percentage of the amount requested by the requestor party, related to a single invoice, to be financed.

AppliedPercentage.name: Applied Percentage
AppliedPercentage.definition: The percentage rate applied to calculate the amount financed.

FinancedAmount.name: Financed Amount
FinancedAmount.definition: Specifies the amount financed which is derived from the applied percentage and the invoice amount..

InvoiceFinancingPartyRole.name: Invoice Financing Party Role
InvoiceFinancingPartyRole.definition: Role played by a party in the context of financing an invoice.

InvoiceFinancingStatus.name: Invoice Financing Status
InvoiceFinancingStatus.definition: Status of the invoice financing transaction and of the different requests linked to it.

Invoice.name: Invoice
Invoice.definition: Invoice to which is referred financing request.

ResultingCashEntry.name: Resulting Cash Entry
ResultingCashEntry.definition: Information related to the crediting of the amount financed, such as dates, amount, charges...

Assignment.name: Assignment
Assignment.definition: Assignments resulting from an invoice financing agreement.
